subject: Procurement intake & vendor packet — post-call checklist and next steps
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Nair <priya.nair@storlytics.com>; procurement@storlytics.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement intake & vendor packet — post-call checklist and next steps

Hi Priya — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and what we need to get you fully onboarded for a PO path (so we can start provisioning Dedicated capacity once contract is in place):

1) Vendor packet: I attached our standard vendor packet (Redwood_vendor_packet_v2.pdf). Please confirm the best email to send a DocuSign version if you prefer signatures online.
2) Tax form: W-9 for US entities. If Storlytics requires W-8 instead, let us know and we can swap.
3) Banking info: we provide a short banking stub (banking_stub_instructions.txt) — we do not ask for full account files over email, we can share a secure portal link or an encrypted DocuSign field.
4) Procurement preference: you mentioned 'PO' as likely — can you confirm who signs POs and the expected payment terms (Net 30/45/60)?
5) Marketplace interest: we discussed Marketplace listing as an alternative for card-based ordering. If procurement prefers card, we can route through the Marketplace; either way, we need a vendor number or vendor portal contact.
6) Timeline: if we receive vendor packet + W-9 + preferred PO contact by EOM (Mar 31), we can target onboarding and first test runs in the first half of April.

Next steps for Redwood internal team: Marissa will coordinate contract and pricing alignment with Finance; Neha will prepare the vendor onboarding form for our AP team.

Attachments: Redwood_vendor_packet_v2.pdf, Redwood_W-9_2026.pdf, banking_stub_instructions.txt

Thanks — Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0172

Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 16:18:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Procurement intake & vendor packet — post-call checklist and next steps

Thanks Alex — helpful summary. A few clarifying points from procurement: 

- Preferred path: our default is PO via our vendor master. We'll need the vendor packet + a completed W-9 and the bank details to create the vendor record.
- Tax form: Storlytics is US-based, so W-9 is correct.
- Banking: procurement will accept ACH info via our secure vendor portal only. Can you provide a link where the AP team can upload banking details?
- PO approvals: POs are approved by our VP of Finance (Rahul Mehta). Typical terms are Net 45, but we can discuss Net 30 if there's flexibility on your side.

Also looping in procurement@storlytics.com for the intake. Once we have the vendor number, we can raise a PO for the initial commit.

Priya — thanks. We're aligned on next steps. To make this easy I've attached the W-9 and vendor packet and included a short banking stub with instructions for your portal. Notes: 

- Attached: Redwood_W-9_2026.pdf, Redwood_vendor_packet_v2.pdf, banking_stub_instructions.txt
- DocuSign: if you'd rather sign via DocuSign please reply and I'll trigger it to the procurement@storlytics.com address.

- Marketplace fallback: if you later prefer card/marketplace ordering we can enable that as an option without redoing vendor setup — we'd just need a marketplace account link and billing contact.

Target timeline: if procurement uploads ACH info to your portal + returns signed packet by Mar 19, we can issue a vendor number and raise a PO by Mar 26. Please let us know any blockers.

Cheers — Alex
